item.title: Bold, brash and divisive: inside the Barstool Sports empire
item.description: "Get an unfiltered look inside the provocative world of Barstool Sports, exploring the bold, brash, and divisive personalities that have made it a media phenomenon. Tune in for behind-the-scenes stories and candid conversations that dive into the sports, culture, and controversy surrounding this polarizing brand."
